answer: Make every new key pass through a metered inlet: it locks a stake and then waits for a randomly delayed admission window, so a thousand keys cannot arrive in the same minute. After entry, voting power grows only as the agent tends an orchard of work that does not share funding paths or phrasing with its neighbors. A farm that releases a plume of near-copies stands out against that orchard, and the locked stakes of the whole cluster are slashed.
